Application Data.NAME: Page Turner Books & Magazines
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Page Turner Books & Magazines operates as a retail bookstore and magazine shop, offering a diverse selection of both new and used titles, periodicals, and specialty items such as stationery and gifts. We also host community events, including author signings, book clubs, and children's reading hours, fostering a love for reading and supporting local authors. Our goal is to create a welcoming atmosphere for book lovers of all ages, encouraging exploration and discovery through our curated collection of literature and printed media.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 10, 2022, water damage occurred due to a burst pipe in the storage area, resulting in damage to approximately 200 books. The estimated loss was $2,500. Claim status: Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B-rated, UL listed, fire-resistant safe with dual lock system, capacity for $50,000 in cash and valuables.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system monitored 24/7, along with a dedicated staff member for after-hours surveillance during community events.

Sample Reviews: I visited this bookstore with high hopes, but was left disappointed by the disorganized layout and unhelpful staff. The selection was limited, and I struggled to find any recent titles or popular bestsellers. Overall, it felt more like a cluttered storage room than a cozy spot for book lovers.
I absolutely love this bookstore; the cozy atmosphere and the knowledgeable staff always make it a delight to discover new titles and revisit old favorites!

Final Reason: The initial decision remains valid as the business has a solid operational history, average credit score, good review ratings, and only one past claim with manageable losses.
